**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no non-compete, field-of-use, exclusivity, or territory restriction on Clear Capital, which meets the playbook's preferred position.

What I checked and why it doesn't bite:
- **§1 Purpose of Engagement / §2 Term** — pure scope and SOW mechanics; no restraint on our business or sourcing. Nothing prevents us engaging other vendors.
- **§6 Termination** — no surviving restrictive covenant; only fee settlement and assignment of work in progress to us.
- **p0047 (Non-Solicitation of Employees)** — mutual ("Neither party"), term plus 12 months, limited to personnel with direct involvement in the Services, consent not unreasonably withheld. It binds RadialSpark equally and restrains hiring, not the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build, so it is outside this rule.
- **p0020** — bars us from reselling or using Contractor's pre-existing proprietary materials outside the software we receive. This is ordinary licence-scope drafting, not a field-of-use restraint on our own products or operations. Worth noting for the IP rule, not this one.
- **p0019** — confirms Contractor may serve other clients; imposes nothing on us.

Searches for "compete/competing", "exclusive", "Company shall not", "restrict", "develop", "solicit", and "similar services" returned no restrictive covenant against us.
